title: Local AI Tutor
oneLine: On-device study assistant: grounded RAG over course docs with local Gemma and deterministic turn resolution.
role: Builder — SwiftUI/SwiftData app, RAG pipeline, local model orchestration
limitations: No language model in the static demo; lexical BM25/TF-IDF stands in for sqlite-vec. Production needs Ollama/local Gemma and optional embed model. Multimodal paths vary by model variant.
